locator.title: Топ-6 нестандартных планировок квартир от Level Group
locator.lead: Покажем несколько вариантов в разных районах Москвы
locator.caption: Открытое пространство создаёт ощущение роскоши, а виды на Москву можно считать своеобразной деталью интерьера

image_reading: A high-rise terrace with lounge chairs, small tables and planted grasses overlooks the river and city skyline.
The pampas grass and small terrace trees are the clearly movable elements; warm indoor light and the open view support a quiet residential mood.
analysis.article_context: Body image for the “Квартира с террасой” section: it illustrates the terrace as a calm evening retreat where the panoramic Moscow view becomes part of the interior.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The terrace feels like a private, peaceful extension of the apartment, with the city view as part of everyday evening relaxation.
structured_intent.primary_action: A gentle breeze moves through the terrace grasses and shrubs.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The visible grasses and shrubs have eased into a soft, gentle sway while the open lounge area and city view remain unobstructed.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The terrace remains a calm, inviting urban retreat throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, a mild breeze begins in the foreground grasses and travels through the potted shrubs along the terrace. The fixed composition keeps the seating and panorama continuously visible; the motion grows naturally, then eases so the plants end in a soft, readable sway near the final frames.
models.positive_prompt: A light evening breeze gradually moves the pampas plumes and terrace shrubs toward the city view at a calm, even pace. Fixed camera. By the final moment, the grasses settle into a gentle sway while the lounge area remains a quiet open retreat.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, wind movement develops smoothly from the front pampas grass to the smaller trees farther down the balcony. Keep the camera still to preserve the spacious terrace and skyline; let the continuous movement taper into a calm final sway close to the end.
models.positive_prompt: A gentle evening breeze passes through the terrace grasses and shrubs, slowly animating the planted edge toward the panoramic city view. Keep the camera fixed; near the end, the foliage settles into a soft lingering sway and the terrace stays serene.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, use a compact, even breeze that becomes visible immediately in the foreground plumes and carries along the terrace planting. The shot remains fixed on the seating and view; the vegetation reaches a gentle sustained sway at the end without introducing another event.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the terrace. A soft evening breeze moves the pampas grass first, then the small shrubs along the balcony toward the city panorama. In the final moment, the foliage rests in a gentle sway, leaving the lounge area quietly inviting.
